items.headline: Does a skull cap actually make you hotter?
items.caption: TikTok's new before-and-after trend is men in beanies.
body: Dazed compares it to 2015's 'Don't Judge' challenge.
The tight cap frames the face.
How to wear it: a snug knit beanie, ears covered.

items.headline: The best jewellery on Vogue's Best Dressed list
items.caption: Margot Robbie borrowed Elizabeth Taylor's Taj Mahal diamond.
body: Céline Dion recreated her 1997 Oscars Chanel necklace.
Colman Domingo is on the list too.
Style lesson: jewellery with a story.

items.headline: Jack O'Connell wore all-black McQueen to the Governors Awards
items.caption: Ultra-wide lapels and polished Jermyn brogues.
body: The suit came from McQueen's SS27 pre-collection.
He stars in 'Sinners'.
Style lesson: all-black, sharp lapels.

items.headline: Is Joseph Zada following Jeremy Allen-White's lead again?
items.caption: From curls and backward caps to something more chic.
body: The 21-year-old stars with Florence Pugh in 'East of Eden'.
He's in the next Hunger Games film too.
Style lesson: grow up your look slowly.

items.headline: The Nudie suit is everywhere again
items.caption: Polly Parsons wore a modern take at the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.
body: Nudie Cohn made famous rhinestone Western suits.
Vogue shows how to get the look.
Style lesson: one embroidered jacket is enough.

items.headline: An Air Jordan 1 for Japanese denim lovers
items.caption: Social Status covered it in sashiko stitching.
body: The North Carolina boutique has worked with Nike for years.
Its last proper Jordan collab was in 2019.
How to wear it: with raw selvedge jeans.

items.headline: Stefano Ricci takes Fall 2027 to Bhutan
items.caption: The tenth chapter of its 'SR Explorer' series.
body: The team visited the Tiger's Nest monastery.
The brand supports Himalayan communities.
Style lesson: travel can inspire a wardrobe.

items.headline: Inside Louis Vuitton's Dolomites vintage car rally
items.caption: An Esquire writer drove nearly century-old cars through the Alps, and won.
body: Some teams navigate with a hundred-page road book.
The cars stay on the road, not under glass.
Style lesson: driving gloves and a good jacket.

items.headline: Dengue-blocking mosquitoes cut infections 68% in Brazil
items.caption: Releasing Wolbachia mosquitoes protected schoolchildren in Belo Horizonte.
body: Wolbachia bacteria stop mosquitoes spreading dengue, Zika and chikungunya.
It worked even during Brazil's biggest dengue outbreak.

items.headline: A school takes coconuts instead of tuition fees
items.caption: Faith Christian Academy on Micronesia's Yap Island accepts coconuts as fees.
body: Families can pay with what they grow.
The coconuts help revive the island's coconut oil industry.

items.headline: Retired teacher turns old guitars into bird feeders
items.caption: Rob Burke's 'Frets and Feathers Cafe' on Prince Edward Island.
body: People donated six guitars, a violin and drum parts.
He had to fix the perches when heavier blue jays arrived.

items.headline: A son is finding the 33 kids who wrote to his wounded dad in 1967
items.caption: Their letters helped a Navy corpsman wounded in Vietnam.
body: Dave Jacobson wants to thank each of them, almost 60 years later.
'It made a difference,' he says.
